text:
Maria K.: Quick check — onboarding mistral-7b-q4: where are the weights for serving? config validator failing on kv_cache_size mismatch. Also seeing tokenizer splitting '℞' into weird tokens in a couple golden prompts.

Aj Patel: Weights are in s3://rwd-models/mistral/mistral-7b-q4-v2/{shard}.pt. Use the manifest at s3://rwd-models/mistral/mistral-7b-q4-v2/manifest.json to populate model.paths. For the kv cache: serving config expects kv_cache_size=2048 but model header shows 4096. Run `rwd-check-model --sync-headers` to update the packaged config or set override in serving config.

Greg L.: Tokenizer note — this model uses a byte-level BPE with an extra unicode normalizer step. '℞' (prescription symbol) gets split into multiple tokens unless normalized. Two options: normalize to NFC before tokenization, or add a small special-case mapping. Example quick patch to tokenizer.json:

```json
{"special_cases": {"℞": ["Ġ", "℞"]}}
```

I'd prefer normalize-first approach so we don't bloat the vocab. Also added a golden prompt for "prescription handling" to the regression set.

Sasha I.: For quality/regression we should also add a structured-output test for tool-calling safety. Expect JSON like: `{\"drug\": \"string\", \"dose\": \"string\", \"instructions\": \"string\"}`. Adding eval harness entry id `golden/regression/med-safety-03`. I'll open a PR with prompts + expected outputs.

Aj Patel: I'll run config validation and patch the serving config. Also planning a small canary rollout (5% traffic) after smoke tests. Canary config snippet I'll add to the model route:

```yaml
rollout:
  strategy: canary
  steps:
    - weight: 5
      duration: 1h
    - weight: 100
      duration: 24h
```

deploy-bot: Triggered canary deployment mistral-7b-q4-v2 -> redwood-dedicated-eu1 (image: rwd-serving:2026-03-17) — job #7732. Logs: starting shard attach, health checks pending...

Maria K.: Thanks — can you post the patched config diff and the test job ID when smoke finished? I'll update the console readiness checklist and coordinate with SRE on peak capacity for the canary window.

Greg L.: PTAL at PR #4512 — added tokenizer patch + golden prompt + eval harness entry. Also included a small unit test for normalization.

Aj Patel: job #7732 completed smoke tests. All endpoints passed latency SLOs for the small traffic sample. Regression eval subset passed except one structured-output case (missing \"dose\"). I pushed a prompt tweak to reduce abbreviation expansions and re-ran that test.

Maria K.: OK moving to canary rollout. I'll monitor logs and the regression dashboard. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
